source.notes: Based on Ozon Seller API public documentation and the local OZON_HD product_cleaner payload shape. Category-specific attributes must still be fetched per description_category_id/type_id.

sellerApiEndpoints.purpose: Fetch attributes for a selected description_category_id/type_id.
Fetch dictionary values for attributes that require dictionary selection.

baseFields.label: Ozon 描述类目 / Type ID
baseFields.aiHint: From Ozon category tree, select the leaf description_category_id and type_id before upload.

baseFields.label: 卖家 SKU / offer_id
baseFields.aiHint: Stable seller SKU. Generate from source platform/product id when missing.

baseFields.label: 商品名称
baseFields.aiHint: Clean product title for Ozon listing. Preserve brand, product type, key spec and core selling point.

baseFields.label: 商品简述 / 简介
baseFields.aiHint: Short listing description from source description, selling points and specs. Keep it factual.

baseFields.label: 标签 / 关键词
baseFields.aiHint: Operational tags/keywords from source hashtags, tags, marketing labels, title and core use cases.

baseFields.label: 品牌
baseFields.aiHint: Extract source brand; when no brand is available, map to allowed no-brand value for the matched category.

baseFields.label: 售价
baseFields.aiHint: Final listing price. Should be calculated from purchase price, logistics, commission and margin rules.

baseFields.label: 原价 / 划线价
baseFields.aiHint: Optional old price for marketing display. Keep consistent with platform rules.

baseFields.label: 最低价
baseFields.aiHint: Optional minimum price for pricing strategy.

baseFields.label: 币种
baseFields.aiHint: Currency code used by the product import payload.

baseFields.label: 条码
baseFields.aiHint: Use source barcode if available; otherwise leave for manual/store policy handling.

baseFields.label: 商品图片
baseFields.aiHint: Primary image plus additional images. Main image, detail images and translated/OCR images are handled by the image workflow.

baseFields.label: 包装尺寸与重量
baseFields.aiHint: Logistics fields are required by product import and shipping calculations.

children.label: 包装重量
children.aiHint: Package weight. Normalize to the unit used in weight_unit.

children.label: 重量单位
children.aiHint: Weight unit used by product import payload.

children.label: 尺寸单位
children.aiHint: Dimension unit used by product import payload.

categorySpecificFields.notes: Do not hard-code category-specific required attributes. Fetch them for the matched category/type, then show required, dictionary and conditional attributes under the category-specific feature block.
